newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: EA-Generali to open unit in Slovakia.
newsitem.headline: EA-Generali to open unit in Slovakia.

text.p: Austrian insurer EA-Generali AG said on Monday it planned to set up a subsidiary in neighbouring Slovakia next year as part of its strategy of expansion in central and eastern Europe.
In a statement, EA-Generali said it would control 100 percent of Bratislava-based Generali Poistovna. Initially the firm would concentrate on vehicle and life insurance.
"The move will round off our presence in central Europe," EA-Generali chief executive Dietrich Karner said.

The insurer, majority owned by Italy's Assicurazione Generali SpA Trieste, earlier this month announced plans to enter the Slovenian market. It is already active in Austria, Germany, Hungary and the Czech Republic. -- Vienna Newsroom 43-1-531 12 254
